question: What is the name of the university with the most research points?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "universities" AS SELECT "university_id" AS "university_id", "city" AS "city", "state" AS "state", "team_name" AS "team_name", "affiliation" AS "affiliation", "enrollment" AS "enrollment", "home_conference" AS "home_conference", "uni_name_prefix" AS "uni_name_prefix", "uni_name_suffix" AS "uni_name_suffix" FROM table_1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "ranking_points" AS SELECT "rank" AS "rank", "reputation_point" AS "reputation_point", "research_point" AS "research_point", "citation_point" AS "citation_point", "total" AS "total", "id_tens" AS "id_tens", "id_units" AS "id_units" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rank_to_university" AS SELECT "rank" AS "rank", "university_id" AS "university_id", "major_id" AS "major_id" FROM table_4;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH named_unis AS (
    SELECT 
        u.university_id,
        TRIM(
            CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(u.uni_name_prefix, ''), NULLIF(u.uni_name_suffix, ''))
        ) AS university_name
    FROM universities u
), points AS (
    SELECT rp.rank, rp.research_point
    FROM ranking_points rp
), linker AS (
    SELECT r.rank, r.university_id
    FROM rank_to_university r
), joined AS (
    SELECT 
        l.university_id,
        p.research_point
    FROM linker l
    JOIN points p ON p.rank = l.rank
)
SELECT 
    n.university_name,
    j.research_point
FROM joined j
JOIN named_unis n ON n.university_id = j.university_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY j.research_point DESC, n.university_name ASC) = 1;
